name: workspaces
title: Workspaces
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Track folders, Git repositories and their worktrees.
description: Keeps a workspace folder list, reads Git/worktree state, opens shells in folders and can create a Git worktree when asked. The sidebar consumes its published workspace data. Turn it off to stop scanning and remove these commands; folders, worktrees and running shells are not deleted.

panels: Workspace data used by the sidebar
